title: Rainforest's Chest Key
summary: Opens the Strongbox in the northern basement storeroom of Rainforest’s Home.

fields.Use: Unlock the strongbox built into the storeroom’s eastern wall.
fields.Acquisition: Behind the eastern wall of the basement study.
